name: Dear Mom: My Letter to You
source:
Dear Mom: My Letter to You is a journey of loss, acceptance, and the bonds made along the way. The story stars high school student Ayame Kawasaki who blames herself for her mother's suicide. Having closed off her connections with her friends for a whole year, Ayame is finally restarting her life, repeating her second year at Yamada Hoshi High School. It's up to Ayame to build and maintain her relationships, new and old, while coming to terms with the reality of her mother's death.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Dear Mom: My Letter to You》讲述一段关于失去、接纳，以及沿途建立羁绊的旅程。故事主角，是将母亲自杀的责任，归咎于自己的高中生Ayame Kawasaki。与朋友断绝来往整整一年后，Ayame终于重新开始生活，回到Yamada Hoshi高中，重读二年级。她必须一边接受母亲已经离世的现实，一边建立、维系新旧关系。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693850/]Steam[/url]]
